natural_body: Price-sensitive SMBs: 40% off drove signup +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction. Verify both records before committing because the interventions may differ and reducing required fields could weaken lead qualification or downstream revenue quality. Run a guarded test measuring completion, activation, qualified pipeline/revenue, and retention rather than optimizing completion alone.
